description: This file defines a Go package 'matchers' that implements an XML matching utility for testing, including parsing and comparing XML content.

classes.name: MatchXMLMatcher
classes.description: A struct that holds the XML content to match against.

classes.name: xmlNode
classes.description: A struct representing an XML node with its name, attributes, content, comments, processing instructions, and child nodes.

methods.name: Match
methods.description: Performs XML content comparison between actual and expected XML.

methods.name: FailureMessage
methods.description: Returns a message when the XML match fails.

methods.name: NegatedFailureMessage
methods.description: Returns a message when the XML match unexpectedly succeeds.

methods.name: formattedPrint
methods.description: Converts actual and expected XML inputs to strings for comparison.

methods.name: parseXmlContent
methods.description: Parses XML string content into an xmlNode structure.

methods.name: newXmlDecoder
methods.description: Creates a new XML decoder with charset support.

methods.name: trimParentNodesContentSpaces
methods.description: Recursively trims whitespace from parent node content.
